item.title: 3 killed in helicopter collision that shut down part of an Oregon highway
item.description: Authorities say two helicopters collided and crashed near a small airport southwest of Portland, Oregon, killing all three on board

item.title: September 2027 trial date set for man charged with attacking White House correspondents’ dinner
item.description: A federal judge has set a September 2027 trial date for a man charged with attempting to kill President Donald Trump at the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner

item.title: Make no bones about it, the giant skeleton has become an American Halloween fixture
item.description: It reared its bony head in 2020, during that first, chaotic pandemic year that was rife with grief and fear but also toilet paper hoarding and questionable lockdown-inspired purchases

item.title: Hugh Jackman, William Shatner and George Takei among those paying tribute to Patrick Stewart
item.description: Patrick Stewart has died at 86, prompting tributes from colleagues and Marvel Studios

item.title: Elke Sommer, German-born star of ‘A Shot in the Dark’ and ‘The Prize,’ dies at 85
item.description: Elke Sommer, the German actor known for her roles in 1960s Hollywood comedies and espionage films, has died at 85

item.title: 'Time is the fire in which we burn': 2 major cast losses rock the passionate 'Star Trek' universe
item.description: First Walter Koenig, who played Ensign Pavel Chekov in the original series during the 1960s, died at age 90

item.title: Serbia's students demand resignations in police, judiciary as they prepare to take power
item.description: Serbia's student movement has demanded the resignations from top officials in the police, intelligence and judiciary after their historic election win against Aleksandar Vucic

item.title: Saudi Arabia says drone intercepted near Islam's holiest city, and other Mideast news
item.description: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels near Islam’s holiest city, a claim the Houthis denied

item.title: Carney, top EU official push Canada associate membership and wider alliance against Trump threats
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and the European Union’s top official pushed to make Canada the bloc’s first “associate member” and build a broader alliance open to other countries, warning that foreign economic pressure threatens their sovereignty as U.S. President Donald Trump wages a trade war against traditional allies

item.title: Dockworkers stage international strikes to denounce arms shipments and demand better conditions
item.description: Dockworkers across Europe and beyond are staging strikes as part of an international campaign against arms shipments and to demand better working conditions

item.title: 'Dixie' map that divided the US into North and South fetches nearly $1 million at auction
item.description: After a brief bidding war, the manuscript map that helped divide the United States into North and South, free and slave states, sold for $950,000

item.title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
item.description: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, is investigating a potential security issue that appears to be a hack

item.title: What to consider if a company that made AI-related job cuts wants you back
item.description: Companies have been slashing jobs to invest in artificial intelligence, raising anxiety among workers who fear they may lose their livelihoods to machines

item.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
item.description: U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm TRM says a North Korean hacking unit was likely behind a massive hack at Binance

item.title: Polymarket paused international trading after a security issue involving a third-party provider
item.description: Polymarket temporarily halted trading on its international platform Thursday due to a security incident involving a third-party provider
